title: Edmund and the Colony
author: Marguerite Whitlock
blurb: Lior Joubert, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
